baseline: same RouterService transport, uniform IID random backend, no fingerprint/scoring/lifecycle; same KV readiness subscribers retained
topology: one server, four NPUs, two TP=2 workers
arrival: closed-loop, same source submission order; not fixed RPS
cache_protocol: same idle reset / new AllBlocksCleared / excluded original warmups / fresh frontend as previous controlled suite
timings: server perf_counter wrappers around fingerprint, choose and lifecycle observer; logging after response; instrumentation overhead exists
timing_limit: observer total spans the whole stream; not all of it delays first token; proxy_e2e is not backend compute time
rng_limit: seed fixes random draws; concurrent arrival/load still affects route decisions
scope: 56 unique source inputs, no truncation, same per-row output caps/EOS; not full PAIO/LBv2, not saturation
classification: diagnostic fixed-subset experiment; enforce-eager; NOT official leaderboard evidence
